Leeds United vs. Tottenham on Premier League highlights

  • 29 May 2023
  • 12:35
  • No Comments

Share article:

Share
Share
Tweet

Leeds United were relegated from the Premier League after suffering another heavy defeat against Tottenham Hotspur in their final home match at Elland Road. It was a foregone conclusion since Everton won their match against Bournemouth and thus stayed up irrespective of what happened in the Leeds-Tottenham clash.

Tottenham were also disappointed notwithstanding their victory due to the fact that they were tipped to  aConference League place by Aston Villa who managed to beat Brighton. And although Leeds brought in Big Sam Allardyce for their final games, it was certainly not enough for them to avoid the drop. Tottenham are also searching for a new manager as Ryan Mason is simply a caretaker to steer the ship at present.

The match started in the worst possible way for Leeds with Tottenham taking the lead after just 2 minutes through Harry Kane. The second came two minutes into the second half, courtesy of Pedro Porro whilst Leeds grabbed themselves a lifeline with a goal by Joe Harrison after an assist by Gary Rutter. However Leeds made sure of the victory with another Kane goal on 69 minutes and Lucas Moura crowned his Tottenham career with a late goal deep in stoppage time with the terraces already emptying away.

Leeds just shaded possession at 52% but out of their 9 shots, they could only manage two of these on target. Conversely, Tottenham were far more ruthless with 48% possession since they managed 8 shots with 7 of these on target.

Leeds United vs. Tottenham Hotspur, highlights from Premier League 2022/23

Goals Scored – Leeds United – 1 Goal

Leeds United had 52% possession throughout the game and had 9 shots in total with 2 of these on target. 

Goals Scored – Tottenham Hotspur – 4 Goals

Tottenham had 48% possession and managed 8 shots in total with 7 of these being on target. 

Goals By Minute

Tottenham scored two goals without reply before Leeds pulled one back. A Harry Kane brace was enough to get them over the line. 

Corners and Cards – Leeds United vs Tottenham Hotspur

Number of Corners – How many corner kicks were there?

Leeds United forced 12 corners with Tottenham Hotspur managing only 3. 

Number Of Cards

There were 3 yellow cards in the game, all of these were for Leeds United

Who has Won – Leeds United vs Tottenham Hotspur?

Tottenham Hotspur won the match against Leeds United by four goals to one to send Leeds down to the Championship. 

Conclusion about the match Leeds United vs Tottenham Hotspur in Premier League 2022/23

Neither team got anything out of this fixture as Tottenham still did not manage a place in Europe whilst Leeds United were relegated.
